message.content: On July 30, 2026, Jennifer Moore shared a message encouraging others to contribute their fitness tips in the gym group chat. Specifically, she stated, "JenniferMoore: Great job today, Li Hua! 💪 Your hard work is really paying off! How about sharing some of your favorite fitness tips with the group? I'm sure everyone would love to hear them! 😊" This implies that Jennifer suggested Li Hua to share his fitness tips with the group.
